## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `de1ff20dd9824262ae8a60336f4cc28fcdc4b8dd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md + none

Inputs read: card #33845 body and all seven comments (triage 6894740652, claim 6895971923, dev report 6896316823, seat analysis 6897235004, ruling 6943066754, claim 6943332292, dev report 6943931286); PR #34739 body, file list and the net diff against `main` (merge-base `f6f5b50a05`, which is `origin/main`); the check-runs on the head. The diff is one file, +1 −1, line 10 of `seat-lifecycle.md`; no implementing file is in the diff, so the scope is `hits` alone.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set change: reading four of the round-open mutex goes from "the first closed card carrying a same-seat `Claim:`" to "the first closed card carrying a same-seat and non-exempt `Claim:`". The set of cards the reading can land on widens past an exempt first card; the set of stand-downs can only grow. Right: this is option A of analysis 6897235004 as ruled in 6943066754, and it agrees with the next line of the same file (line 11, 「三、四只增自退」).
- Public surface: none. `.claude/**` ships in no released package; no schema, no script, no label, no record shape and no gate changes. Reading four has no script implementation at this head (`git grep 读数四` over `scripts`, `docs`, `AGENTS.md` returns nothing), so no code has to follow the sentence. Right.
- Ratchet surface: the file is 100 lines at head against the unchanged row `seat-lifecycle.md, 100` in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (the script is not in the diff, so no ceiling moved); line 10 is 120 bytes, at the 120-byte cap and not over it; no line in the file exceeds 120 bytes; the table-row pin row (0) is untouched. Right, and it is the premise the ruling set ("one line changed, no line added", no ceiling raise).
- Gate verdicts, from the check-runs on the head: every completed run concluded success or skipped, none failed. That includes `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset` and `Check PR Size`. One run, `Type Check · consumer gates`, was still in progress when read: pending, not a verdict; the seat reads its conclusion before the landing step.

### ② Semver level

No changeset, `skip-changeset` label on the PR, `Check Changeset` success on the head. The diff publishes nothing (one line of internal skill prose under `.claude/**`), so no bump is owed and the label is the right carrier.

Clause-②: no — the PR body and the card both carry `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the tree agrees: no published spec, protocol or package surface is touched.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1 (the PR body omits the signed trailer the dispatch asked for): accepted. It is PR-body text, not tree; the dev rule bans that form in dev-written text and the seat owns the trailer.
- Dev deviation 2 (the maintainer summary carries six fixed lines): accepted; PR-body form, no effect on the reviewed file.
- Dev deviation 3 (one merge of `origin/main` before the PR opened): accepted. The reviewed head is the merged head, its merge-base equals `origin/main`, the net diff is still the single line, and the check-runs above are on that head.
- `open_questions`: empty on report 6943931286. The one earlier open question (N14, report 6896316823) is answered by ruling 6943066754, letter A; the PR implements A and nothing else.
- Ruling guard ("if the premise does not hold on `main`, report; do not raise the ratchet ceiling"): the premise held; no ceiling row moved.
- Governed surface: `.claude/**` is governed, the PR is draft and stays draft until the governed approvers approve. Tier H approval and the landing through the queue are the seat's step, not this record's.
- For the seat, outside the tree: the PR closes the card with `Fixes`, and the card body still shows all eight boxes unticked although seven items landed with PR #33943; ticking them is the seat's bookkeeping.
- Disclosure: the only command run locally was the template printer this record's shape is defined by; no gate, build or test ran.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff holds no query, no id materialisation and no join; it is one line of rule prose.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md`, line 10, judged against ruling 6943066754, analysis 6897235004 and the live text on `main`.

- Says what the ruling decided, no more and no less. The ruling: "take the first card that carries a `Claim:` with the same seat number and is not exempt. One line changed, no line added." The head inserts 「且非豁免」 after 「同席号」 and changes nothing else; the wording is the exact string the analysis measured (120 bytes). Nothing beyond the ruling rides the line: no stop rule, no new key, no reorder.
- No contradiction on `main`. Line 5 (four readings, stand down on unreleased activity younger than one round), line 8 (reading three), line 11 (the non-occupying set and "three and four only add stand-downs"), `area-lease.md` line 29 (the area session reads the mutex "as `seat-lifecycle.md` says"), `platform-readings.md` line 358 (a claim hidden by leading markup is invisible to readings three and four), `seat-post-protocol.md` lines 34 and 43, `cross-repo-coordination.md` line 12 and `SKILL.md` line 81 were read at head; none states a rule for reading four that the new qualifier breaks, and none restates the old one-sample wording.
- Every name on the line is real at head: `state=CLOSED` and `updated_at` are the platform's issue fields, `Claim:` is the claim marker the tree recognises (`CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER`, cited in `platform-readings.md`). The line names no gate, label, script or path, new or old.
- Break attempts. (a) A card carrying two same-seat claims, one exempt and one not: the qualifier binds the claim, so the card counts and the session read is the non-exempt one; correct. (b) A reader outside the lease table (a duplicate or recovered session): by line 11 the exemption is mutual inside the group only, so the area sessions' claims are not exempt for that reader and it stands down; this is the conservative direction and is what the ruling wants. (c) A lane with no area lease: nothing is exempt, the reading is what it was on `main`. (d) A lane where every recent closed card is exempt: the reading walks past them all and finds an old card or none; no stand-down, which is the same outcome the old letter gave, reached later. No case found where the new text yields fewer stand-downs than the old, or a stand-down the ruling did not intend.
- Followable as written, with two residual gaps, both disclosed to the maintainer in the analysis before the ruling and both unfixable inside the ruling's bound (the line is at the byte cap and no line may be added):

T1 (nit) — 「豁免」 appears once in the file and is not defined there; the only text it can bind to is the non-occupying set on line 11 directly below, which is spelled 「不占席」, not 「豁免」. A seat resolves it by adjacency and by the ruling, and both plausible readings of the set give the same conduct for same-seat claims, so the contract is unaffected. Left as an accepted deviation; aligning the two words belongs to the next touch of lines 10 and 11.

T2 (nit) — the walk has no stated stop. Line 5 makes activity older than one round irrelevant, so a reader may stop at the first closed card older than a round, but that is an inference from line 5, not the letter of line 10; read literally the seat walks to the first non-exempt card however old. The result is the same either way; only the read cost differs. Left for a follow-up card if the walk proves long in an area-mode lane.

Line economy: no duplication introduced (the qualifier is stated once, in the one line that needs it), no unactionable text added, budget and ratchet as in ①.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
